what: the numbers the live demo prints, as computed by code/build_live_demo.py

text.pill: REPLAY of stored forecasts · test years Oct 2005 – Sep 2014
text.models_tip: 3 Models. One LSTM for all 12 basins (64 cells) against three simple baselines: tomorrow = today, ridge regression, random forest. Each forecast on this page is the average of the model's trainings: five for the rain to midnight and the weather forecast, three for the rain table and perfect weather; early stopping on the validation years.
text.score_tip: 5 Score. NSE, KGE, onsets warned, false warnings, CSI. Verdicts fixed in advance: GO = at least 70% of onsets warned and at most 30% false; CAUTION = CSI at least 0.40; otherwise NOT YET. Headline numbers recomputed by independent AI reviewer agents.
text.clock_src: Rain by the hour: AORC, the basin mean the model reads (an analysis made after the fact), from 09:00 the day before the issue day to midnight of the onset day. 09:00 stands for the end of the rain table's day: 08:48 at the median river, 07:26 to 18:16 by river (standard time); midnight is the issue time (wall clock).
text.note: A replay on the test years of the stored forecasts, re-scored with the engine's own rule. The rain to midnight is AORC, an analysis made after the fact (hindsight at most about 4 points); with the real-time radar product in its place 48% of the onsets are warned against 52% (45% with the last hour of each issue day left out, since the one-hour delay of Stage IV is not simulated): a check on the test years, not a service. Nothing on this page is a live forecast.
text.realtime_short: a check on the test years, not a service
text.gloss: Words. AORC, a radar- and gauge-anchored hourly rain product of NOAA (an analysis made after the fact: its daily totals come from rain gauges and are spread over the hours with radar, with corrections about ten days behind real time). Stage IV: NOAA's real-time radar and gauge rain. GEFSv12: NOAA's archived weather forecast (the reforecast, control member). Rain table: Daymet, the daily weather table the models read; its day ends near 09:00. CSI = warned / (warned + missed + false warnings). Hindsight: how much of the AORC result may come from its after-the-fact daily anchoring.
